q: 활성 고객의 주문에 대한 반품은 모두 몇 건인가요?
ref: SELECT count(*) FROM iceberg.default.product_returns pr JOIN iceberg.default.orders o ON o.id = pr.order_id JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.is_active = true

q: 플래티넘 고객의 주문은 몇 건인가요?
ref: SELECT count(*) FROM iceberg.default.orders o JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'platinum'

q: 플래티넘 고객 주문의 총 주문 금액(total_amount) 합계는 얼마인가요?
ref: SELECT sum(o.total_amount) FROM iceberg.default.orders o JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'platinum'

q: 취소 주문의 총 주문 금액(total_amount) 합계는 얼마인가요?
ref: SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM iceberg.default.orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

q: 고객 국가별 취소 주문 건수를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT c.country, count(*) FROM iceberg.default.orders o JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.country

q: 고객 국가별 청구서 금액 합계를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT c.country, sum(i.amount) FROM iceberg.default.invoices i JOIN iceberg.default.orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

q: 플래티넘 고객의 결제 금액 합계를 결제 수단별로 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT p.method, sum(p.amount) FROM iceberg.default.payments p JOIN iceberg.default.invoices i ON i.id = p.invoice_id JOIN iceberg.default.orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'platinum' GROUP BY p.method

q: 창고 코드별 배송 건수를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT w.code, count(*) FROM iceberg.default.shipments s JOIN iceberg.default.warehouses w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.code

q: 상품 카테고리별 반품 건수를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT p.category, count(*) FROM iceberg.default.product_returns r JOIN iceberg.default.products p ON p.id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.category

q: 고객 등급(tier)별 고객 문의 건수를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT c.tier, count(*) FROM iceberg.default.support_tickets t JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.tier

q: 캠페인 이름별로 접촉한 활성 고객 수(중복 제외)를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT k.name, count(DISTINCT c.id) FROM iceberg.default.campaign_touches t JOIN iceberg.default.campaigns k ON k.id = t.campaign_id JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id WHERE c.is_active = true GROUP BY k.name

q: 회원 등급별 주문 수를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT c.tier, count(*) FROM iceberg.default.orders o JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.tier

q: 구매자 국가별 평균 주문 금액(total_amount)을 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT c.country, avg(o.total_amount) FROM iceberg.default.orders o JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

q: 인보이스 상태별 결제 금액 합계를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT i.status, sum(p.amount) FROM iceberg.default.payments p JOIN iceberg.default.invoices i ON i.id = p.invoice_id GROUP BY i.status

q: 제품 카테고리별 창고 재고(on_hand) 합계를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT p.category, sum(i.on_hand) FROM iceberg.default.inventory i JOIN iceberg.default.products p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category

q: 활성 고객의 고객 문의를 우선순위별 건수로 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT t.priority, count(*) FROM iceberg.default.support_tickets t JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id WHERE c.is_active = true GROUP BY t.priority

q: 취소 주문에 담긴 상품 수량(quantity) 합계는 얼마인가요?
ref: SELECT sum(oi.quantity) FROM iceberg.default.order_items oi JOIN iceberg.default.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

q: 창고가 있는 국가별 재고(on_hand) 합계를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT w.country, sum(i.on_hand) FROM iceberg.default.inventory i JOIN iceberg.default.warehouses w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.country

q: 플래티넘 고객 주문에서 나온 반품의 환불 금액(refund_amount) 합계는 얼마인가요?
ref: SELECT sum(r.refund_amount) FROM iceberg.default.product_returns r JOIN iceberg.default.orders o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN iceberg.default.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'platinum'

q: 결제 수단별 결제 금액 합계를 알려주세요.
ref: SELECT method, sum(amount) FROM iceberg.default.payments GROUP BY method
